understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by matching the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to each goal, then stepping onto the matching goal cell.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement consumes stamina, and blocked moves still consume stamina. Shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90 degrees clockwise. A goal is only completed when all three attributes match while stepping onto it. Running out of stamina costs a life and resets stamina, so movement must be planned carefully.
